name: Formation and back office
what: Formation services, registered agents, banking, e-signature, accounting, accreditation checks, and the government filing systems sponsors use.

tasks.title: Start the core transaction
tasks.question: Can an agent start the product's core transaction, such as a filing, an envelope, a payment, a verification or an invoice, through an API, leaving signatures and approvals to a person?
tasks.full: API documentation shows the core transaction can be created programmatically.
tasks.partial: Only drafts or prefilled forms can be created, or only through a partner integration.

tasks.title: Check status
tasks.question: Can an agent check the status of an order, filing, envelope, payment or verification through an API or structured feed?
tasks.full: A documented API or structured feed returns the status of the customer's transactions.
tasks.partial: Status only by email notices, or only for some transaction types.

tasks.title: Retrieve finished records
tasks.question: Can an agent retrieve finished documents and records, such as filed documents, signed envelopes, statements or verification letters, programmatically?
tasks.full: A documented API returns the finished documents or records.
tasks.partial: Only some document types, or only by download links sent by email.
